༄༅/ /bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi bka' srung dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i mchod gsol bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi bka' srung dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i mchod gsol bsdus pa bzhugs so//

dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu'i gsol ka ni/ drag sngags so lnga pa'i mjug tu/ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭān e dza bhyo: sha trūn hur thums dza mā ra ya rbad/ ma hā de wa e/ u ma de wī e/ ya ma rā tsa ya/ ya ma danti ya/ ma ma ru lu ma/ e ka dzā ti trag /du khrag du/ dunting du/ rā tsa tsa/ ging ka ra tri/ badzra sā dhu tri/ rā hu la rā/ raksha ra/ rakmo ra/ yaksha kṣa/ yakmo kṣa/ ma hā kā la kṣiṃ/ ru dra rnṛ/ mun mun pa/ tirti ka tha/ de wa a/ a se la a/ tgisna 'dre ruṃ tsam/ a bi shu kṣu/ tri pa sha la tri/ haṃ shaṃ tri/ bi nā ya ka u/ ḍā ki nī maṃ/ nā ga rā dza nā ga kro dhī shwa rī phu/ sarba duṣṭān hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ sa spyan drang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ri rab 'dod yon sna tshogs su bsam/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa: dbang phyug che sogs lha srin sde brgyad la: rnam dag bdud rtsi dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul: mthu rtsal drag po'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: 'dod yon rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang: las ngan nyams pa bsgral pa'i rakta dang: dug gsum rnam dag sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs: dregs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul: dgra bo gdug pa bsgral phyir bzhes su gsol: lha srin sde brgyad khyed rnams mchod pa'i dam rdzas ni: dkar dmar la sogs kha dog bye brag rnams: lha srin sde brgyad sku la mchod par 'bul: snyan dang mi snyan sgra yi bye brag rnams: lha srin sde brgyad gsung la mchod par 'bul: tsitta smug po rdza ltar spungs pa yang: lha srin sde brgyad thugs la mchod par 'bul: sku gsung thugs kyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: sgrol ging pho mos las rnams sgrub par mdzod: lha srin sde brgyad 'dir spyon sha la spyon: dam nyams dgra bo'i sha ni zan bas zhim: lha srin sde brgyad 'dir spyon khrag la spyon: dam nyams dgra bo'i khrag ni chang bas zhim: lha srin sde brgyad 'dir spyon rus la spyon:

dam nyams dgra bo'i rus ni mar bas zhim: lha srin sde brgyad rnams la dug gsum mchod par 'bul: dug gsum bzhes la dgra bgegs bsgral du gsol: oṃ ma hā de wa e/ u ma de wī e/ ya ma rā tsa ya/ ya ma danti ya/ ma ma ru lu ma/ e ka dzā ti trag /du khrag du/ dunting du/ rā tsa tsa/ ging ka ra tri/ badzra sā dhu tri/ rā hu la rā/ raksha ra/ rakmo ra/ yaksha kṣa/ yakmo kṣa/ ma hā kā la kṣiṃ/ ru dra rnṛ/ mun mun pa/ tirti ka tha/ de wa a/ a se la a/ tgisna 'dre ruṃ tsam/ a bi shu kṣu/ tri pa sha la tri/ haṃ shaṃ tri/ bi nā ya ka u/ ḍā ki nī maṃ/ nā ga rā dza nā ga kro dhī shwa rī phu/ sarba duṣṭān ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: ma hā pañtsa khā hi: ma hā rakta khā hi: lan gsum gyi rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sa ma ya a mṛta khā hi: snying nye bran pho bran mo'i tshogs: dam las ma 'da' sa ma ya: bdag gi srung mar mnga' gsol lo: sangs rgyas bstan pa khyed kyis srungs: dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyed kyis bstod: rnal 'byor sku dgra khyed kyis sgrol: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: dbang phyug ma hā de wa dang: btsun mo u ma de wī bcas: 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: 'chi bdag ya ma rā tsa dang: skye 'gro'i srog gi bdag mo bcas: 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: ma mo srid pa'i rgyal mo dang: sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi bcas: 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: bdud po kos rje brang dkar dang: bdud mo nag mo re tī bcas:

'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: rgyal po chen po be kar dang: srog bdag tshangs pa dkar ser bcas: 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: skyes mchog rdo rje legs pa dang: bza' bdud chen po rā hu la: 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: srin po nag po glog phreng dang: srin mo sbal mgo khrag mig bcas: 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: gnod sbyin yaksha me dbal dang: gnod sbyin mon mo nag mo bcas: 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: dmu bdud nag po bkrag med dang: mu stegs gu lang nag po bcas: 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: gza' bdud mun pa ke tu dang: klu bdud ka la yaksha bcas/ 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: srid pa'i lha rabs sham po dang: gnam sman thog gi bu yug bcas: 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: ma sangs g.ya' spang skyes gcig dang: brag btsan srog zan dmar po bcas:

'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: srog bdag gnam the'u dkar po dang: btsan 'gong yam shud dmar po bcas: 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: bgegs rgyal bi nā ya ka dang: dpal ldan nag mo mgyogs byed bcas: 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: bkra shis dam ldan mthu che ba: snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhengs: klu bdud nag po mgo dgu dang: klu mo nag mo gdug byed bcas: 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi zab gter las phyungs pa'o/// /
